title: AI Game Player for MUDPuppy — Design Document, Version 3
summary: Design spec for an AI autopilot that drives a MUDPuppy game character via Gemini, with profile-scoped config, safety gate, coaching, memory, and an Alter Aeon acceptance run.
scope: Connection profiles (conduct rules, approach guidance, AI settings)
Safety and Abuse policy acceptance gate
Internal Command Module automation context and safety limits
Coaching chat pane (pause, resume, promote guidance)
Progression tally, session debriefs, learned notes
notes: Type set by MANIFEST_TYPE=SPEC. Content is a mix of goal statement, numbered deliverables with acceptance criteria, sequencing, and out-of-scope list; heuristic path signal (**/specs/**) also supports SPEC, though the acceptance-criteria style has PRD flavor. Filename suffix uses a fallback identifier because no shell was available to compute SHA-256 of the path.
